description: English transcription of the first two sets of criteria fixed before the runs (2026-09-16 to 2026-09-18). The originals (Turkish keys) are kept byte for byte under predictions/frozen/ and their SHA-256 values are listed here; tests/test_predictions.py checks that every expected value below equals the value in the frozen file. The grader (sprat.analysis.predictions) reads this file. The third set, for the transmission spectra with the guide continued into the absorber (2026-09-24, with its amendment), is graded by sprat.analysis.termination; tests/test_termination.py checks its constants against the two frozen files.

first.note: P1 to P11 were frozen on 2026-09-16 before any run; P12 and P13 on 2026-09-16, from a working document of the author that the frozen file names; H8 and H10 recorded on 2026-09-17 before the first verification run. Nothing was edited after the results were seen.

second.note: Criteria PA1 to PA6 for the second-radius runs and PB1 to PB5 for a resolution study of the filling fraction; the PB criteria were closed by the two-sided bound of the stored field instead of the study (see the frozen file, PB_closure).
